name: Nanantius
sum: Albian enantiornithean from Queensland, Australia, known from a tibiotarsus.
holotype: QM F12992, a tibiotarsus from Warra Station near Boulia, Queensland.
material: The holotype tibiotarsus and a referred vertebra.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Molnar 1986
